 Schools closed in Ganjam and Gajapati districts till October 31 due to incessant rainfall and severe flood conditions across southern Odisha. The state administration has ordered the closure of all Anganwadi centres, primary and high schools, degree colleges, technical institutions, and university departments across both affected districts to ensure student safety. Heavy downpours have triggered localized inundation and disrupted connectivity in several areas. Watch the full report for official guidelines, district administration announcements, and weather forecast updates.
